meta.title: Acceptable Use Policy — ResearchChem.uk
meta.description: Acceptable use policy governing access to and use of the ResearchChem.uk website and products.

sections.heading: 1. Purpose
sections.body: This Acceptable Use Policy sets out the terms under which you may access and use the ResearchChem.uk website and purchase products from us. By using this website, you agree to comply with this policy. Breach of this policy may result in immediate termination of your access and cancellation of any orders.

sections.heading: 2. Permitted Use
sections.body: You may use this website solely to browse our product catalogue, place orders for legitimate scientific research purposes, and access information relevant to your research activities. All use must comply with applicable UK law and the laws of your jurisdiction.

sections.heading: 3. Prohibited Uses
sections.body: You must not use this website or purchase products from us for any of the following purposes: human or veterinary consumption or administration; resale to individuals who are not qualified research professionals; any unlawful purpose; any purpose that violates the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971, the Psychoactive Substances Act 2016, or any other applicable legislation; or any purpose that could bring ResearchChem.uk into disrepute.

sections.heading: 4. Age & Professional Eligibility
sections.body: You must be at least 18 years of age and a qualified research professional to use this website and purchase products. By accessing the site you confirm that you meet these requirements. We reserve the right to verify your eligibility and to refuse or cancel orders where eligibility cannot be confirmed.

sections.heading: 5. Misrepresentation
sections.body: You must not misrepresent your identity, professional status, or intended use of products when placing an order or communicating with us. Any misrepresentation constitutes a material breach of this policy and may result in legal action.

sections.heading: 6. Website Conduct
sections.body: You must not attempt to gain unauthorised access to any part of this website or its underlying systems; introduce viruses, malware, or other harmful code; conduct denial-of-service attacks; scrape or harvest data from the site without our written consent; or use automated tools to place orders or interact with the site.

sections.heading: 7. Intellectual Property
sections.body: You must not reproduce, copy, distribute, or commercially exploit any content from this website without our prior written consent. All trademarks, logos, and content are the property of ResearchChem.uk or its licensors.

sections.heading: 8. Reporting Misuse
sections.body: If you become aware of any misuse of this website or our products, please report it immediately to info@research-chem.uk. We take all reports seriously and will investigate promptly.

sections.heading: 9. Consequences of Breach
sections.body: Breach of this Acceptable Use Policy may result in immediate suspension of your access to the website, cancellation of pending orders, reporting to relevant authorities where unlawful activity is suspected, and civil or criminal legal action.

sections.heading: 10. Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We reserve the right to update this Acceptable Use Policy at any time. Continued use of the website following any changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

sections.heading: 11. Contact
sections.body: For any queries regarding this policy, please contact info@research-chem.uk.
